bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to arts and cultural heritage; appropriating money for Oromo youth programs.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; OROMO YOUTH PROGRAMS. +]

[+$200,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $200,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the commissioner of administration for a grant to HIRPHA International for youth programs in the metropolitan area, as defined in Minnesota Statutes, section 473.121, that celebrate Oromo cultural heritage and arts. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to arts and cultural heritage; appropriating money for Oromo youth programs.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; OROMO YOUTH PROGRAMS.

$200,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $200,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the commissioner of administration for a grant to HIRPHA International for youth programs in the metropolitan area, as defined in Minnesota Statutes, section 473.121, that celebrate Oromo cultural heritage and arts.
additions: $200,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $200,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the commissioner of administration for a grant to HIRPHA International for youth programs in the metropolitan area, as defined in Minnesota Statutes, section 473.121, that celebrate Oromo cultural heritage and arts.
